channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: UN mission in Democratic Republic of Congo warns of wave of attacks in east
item.description: The UN mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo warns of a wave of attacks in the east, a region plagued by conflict involving armed groups, militia, and army troops for three decades.

item.title: UK sends warship to Middle East as Trump awaits Iran’s response to peace plan – live
item.description: The UK sent a warship to the Middle East. Tensions are high as Trump awaits Iran's response to a peace plan. UK sends warship to Middle East as Trump awaits Iran’s response to peace plan – live The Independent.

item.title: Army is fighting 'aggressive' NATO-backed force: Putin in Victory Day speech
item.description: Russian President Putin says the army is fighting an aggressive NATO-backed force, in a Victory Day speech that saw a vastly scaled-back parade with no military hardware on display.

item.title: Iran reviewing U.S. proposal at 'own pace' as Trump awaits response, says report
item.description: Iran is reviewing a US proposal at its own pace. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio expects a response from Iran. The report said expectations had grown that Tehran would issue a response after U. S.

item.title: Thomas Silva sprints to victory in Giro stage 2 after nearly 20 riders crash
item.description: Thomas Silva won stage 2 of the Giro after nearly 20 riders crashed, leaving him to sprint to victory. Thomas Silva sprints to victory in Giro stage 2 after nearly 20 riders crash.

item.title: Palestinians run West Bank freedom marathon along separation wall
item.description: Palestinians ran a marathon along the separation wall in the West Bank, a structure that cuts them off from their land and families. Palestinians ran alongside the separation wall today, a structure that cuts them off from their land and their families.

item.title: One dead in US after being struck by taking off Frontier Airlines plane
item.description: One person died after being struck by a taking off Frontier Airlines plane in Denver. Authorities say individual jumped fence at Denver International Airport in Colorado before being struck. One dead in US after being struck by taking off Frontier Airlines plane.

item.title: WHO chief reassures Tenerife residents ahead of arrival of virus-hit cruise ship
item.description: The WHO chief, Tedros Ghebreyesus, reassured Tenerife residents that the arrival of a virus-hit cruise ship on Sunday is not a repeat of the Covid pandemic. "This is not another Covid," Tedros Ghebreyesus tells islanders before MV Hondius docks on Sunday.

item.title: New US Sanctions Target Companies Helping Iran’s Military Sector
item.description: The US imposed sanctions on companies aiding Iran's military sector. New US Sanctions Target Companies Helping Iran’s Military Sector Modern Diplomacy.

item.title: Israel to release two detained Gaza flotilla activists
item.description: Israel will release two Gaza flotilla activists to their home countries. Lawyer representing Saif Abu Keshek and Thiago Avila tells Al Jazeera they will be 'released to their home countries'.

item.title: UK warship HMS Dragon heads to Middle East for potential Strait of Hormuz mission
item.description: UK warship HMS Dragon is heading to the Middle East for a potential mission. The Ministry of Defence says the ship will prepare to join an international mission to safeguard shipping, but only when fighting in the region ends.

item.title: Indonesian rescuers find 1 body after volcano eruption as search continues for 2 more
item.description: Indonesian rescuers found one body after a volcano eruption on Halmahera island. Rescuers on May 9, recovered the body of an Indonesian woman who was caught in a volcanic eruption at Mount Dukono on Indonesia’s remote island of Halmahera a day earlier, as search operations continued to find the bodies of two Singaporeans.

item.title: Bahrain rounds up dozens over alleged links to Iran’s IRGC
item.description: Bahrain arrested 41 people over alleged links to Iran's IRGC. Interior Ministry says legal proceedings are under way against the 41 people arrested. Bahrain rounds up dozens over alleged links to Iran’s IRGC.

item.title: WHO chief arrives in Spain to coordinate hantavirus ship evacuation
item.description: The WHO chief arrived in Spain to coordinate a ship evacuation due to hantavirus cases. The only hantavirus strain that can transmit from person to person. Andes virus.

item.title: Search continues for 2 missing Singaporean hikers after Mount Dukono eruption; 7 to return home: MFA
item.description: Seven Singaporean hikers are returning home after being evacuated from Mount Dukono. Two hikers remain missing. The seven Singaporean hikers who were evacuated from Mount Dukono are currently en route to Jakarta and will travel home to Singapore on Sunday.

item.title: Peter Magyar sworn in as Hungary’s PM, ending Orban’s 16 years in power
item.description: Peter Magyar was sworn in as Hungary's PM, ending Orban's 16-year rule with a huge parliamentary majority. Magyar's Tisza party has secured a huge parliamentary majority. Peter Magyar sworn in as Hungary’s PM, ending Orban’s 16 years in power.

item.title: Israel to release two Gaza flotilla activists ahead of deportation: rights group
item.description: Israel will release two Gaza flotilla activists ahead of deportation. Saif and Avila were detained for over a week. After over a week of Israeli detention, Saif and Avila are said to be released.

item.title: Manchester City vs Brentford
item.description: Manchester City faces Brentford. City chases Arsenal with full team news coverage and text commentary. Follow our live build-up, with full team news coverage, ahead of our text commentary stream as City chase Arsenal.

item.title: ‘Watching us is like watching a cousin’: the online creators reshaping Africa’s news ecosphere
item.description: Africa is leading a change in news consumption habits. Online creators like Amahle-Imvelo Jaxa post videos on current affairs, reshaping the continent's news ecosphere. Jaxa's TikTok video explained an argument between South African and Rwandan presidents.

item.title: Iran says it will play at 2026 World Cup if hosts address ‘concerns’
item.description: Iran will play at the 2026 World Cup if hosts address concerns. Iran's presence at the tournament has been shrouded in uncertainty since the US and Israel launched war on the country.
